skins.name: Tons of Sunshine
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tons of Sunshine
skins.description: Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.

skins.name: Alighting
skins.description: Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.

skins.name: Dangerous Invitation
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Dangerous Invitation
skins.description: A graceful custom-made suit just for Arene. The stiff material is painstakingly cut to fit his youthful figure. He also personally selected the accompanying perfume.

skins.name: Heavenly Mirage
skins.code: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Heavenly Mirage
skins.description: Recreation of a Lungmen VIP 's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.

skins.name: Saturated Within Rain
skins.code: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Saturated Within Rain
skins.description: Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.

skins.name: The Land With Me
skins.code: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/The Land With Me
skins.description: Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.

skins.name: Decoration
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Decoration
skins.description: A cute dress Harmonie rarely wears. With its adjustable fit and flexible materials, it can accentuate the body's natural curves better than any other. The accessories are all from her beloved private collection.
